title: Data Engineer (m/w/d)
description: We are looking for a Data Engineer to build and maintain our data pipelines. Requirements: strong SQL, hands-on experience with Apache Airflow for orchestration, dbt for transformations, and a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake or BigQuery. You will work with Spark and Kafka for streaming ingestion. Nice to have: Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform, and CI/CD experience. Python is required.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description: Your profile: several years building ELT pipelines with Airflow and dbt. Deep knowledge of data modeling and data warehousing. Experience with AWS (Redshift) or GCP. Comfortable with Python, SQL, Docker and version control (Git). Bonus: Airbyte or Fivetran, Databricks.

title: Analytics Engineer
description: As an Analytics Engineer you own the transformation layer: dbt models on top of Snowflake, tested and documented. Strong SQL and data modeling. You orchestrate with Airflow, ingest with Fivetran, and track quality with Great Expectations. Python for tooling. Git and CI/CD are standard here.

title: Platform / Data Engineer
description: Build our streaming platform: Kafka, Spark and Databricks on AWS. Infrastructure as code with Terraform, deployments via Docker and Kubernetes. Strong Python and SQL. You care about CI/CD, observability and data modeling. Orchestration with Airflow or Dagster.

title: Data Scientist
description: As a Data Scientist you will design experiments and predictive models. Requirements: solid statistics, A/B testing, regression and classification, time series forecasting. Strong Python with pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn and XGBoost. You visualize results with matplotlib, seaborn and Plotly, and build dashboards (Tableau or Power BI). Bonus: statsmodels, Optuna. SQL is expected.

title: Senior Data Scientist
description: You lead analyses end to end: statistics, hypothesis testing, A/B testing and time series forecasting. Strong Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit-learn, statsmodels). Communicate with data visualization in seaborn and Plotly. Comfortable writing SQL against Snowflake. Bonus: XGBoost, LightGBM, Optuna.

title: Product Data Scientist
description: Drive product decisions with experimentation and causal analysis. Requirements: statistics, A/B testing, regression. Strong Python with pandas and scikit-learn. You build dashboards in Tableau or Power BI and present to stakeholders. SQL required. R (tidyverse, ggplot2, dplyr) is a plus.

title: Machine Learning Engineer
description: Requirements: production machine learning with feature engineering, deep learning (PyTorch, Keras or TensorFlow), and model tracking with MLflow. You serve models via FastAPI and deploy them with Docker and Kubernetes. Strong Python and SQL. Familiarity with scikit-learn, LightGBM and XGBoost. Hyperparameter tuning with Optuna.

title: NLP Engineer
description: We build NLP products. Your skills: text classification, named entity recognition, embeddings, large language models (LLM) and the Hugging Face transformers ecosystem. Experience with spaCy, NLTK, Gensim and LangChain. We ship demos with Streamlit. Zero-shot classification is a plus. Python required, some data engineering with Airflow to feed the pipelines.

title: MLOps Engineer
description: Own the ML platform: model training pipelines, feature engineering, experiment tracking with MLflow, deployment via Docker, Kubernetes and FastAPI. Strong Python. Deep learning with PyTorch or TensorFlow. You automate with CI/CD and infrastructure as code (Terraform). Familiar with Ray for distributed training.

title: Applied Scientist, NLP
description: Research and ship NLP models: embeddings, named entity recognition, text classification and large language models (LLM). Deep learning with PyTorch, the Hugging Face transformers stack, spaCy and Gensim. Strong Python. Feature engineering and evaluation. Bonus: LangChain, retrieval and zero-shot classification.

title: Data Scientist, Forecasting
description: Forecast demand at scale: time series forecasting, backtesting, regression. Strong Python with pandas, NumPy, statsmodels and XGBoost. Feature engineering and model evaluation. You query data with SQL from BigQuery and visualize with matplotlib and Plotly. Airflow schedules the retraining.
